Dialogs.Dialog: Kobayakawa
Do you know Ultra Combiner Volvavin？
Volvavin？ Oh, I know it！ I watched it in grade school.
My little brother's hooked on it right now.
Huh, reruns？ "Rise, Volvavin！ Volve Fuuusion!!" Right？
So... what's fun about it？
Well, the cool robot transforms and combines, and follows orders？
Hmm... I don't get the appeal.
(The appeal？)
Kobayakawa
Hey, is Volvavin actually a robot in the end？ Or some kind of living thing？
Volvavin？ Ah, I think... it had Rintaro's mother's DNA or something...
I see. That's why it moves on its own when he's in trouble...
Then is Special Minister X a good guy？ Or a bad guy？
Um... what was it？ It turned out to be a government conspiracy or something？
A conspiracy!? Then what about Unit 2, from the ancient ruins？
(Wait, is ▲小早川＊▲ hooked on it too？)
Kobayakawa
Hey, did you play Volvavin when you were little？
Play？ Nah, I was already in fifth grade when it aired.
I see... My brother's really into playing Volvavin, but it's not going well...
Oh, is ▲小早川＊▲ the enemy robot？
No. Rintaro. Because our names sound alike, he says.
Haha！ So your brother's Volvavin.
It's not funny. He wants orders every day. "What next？ What next？"
That does sound rough...
Oh yeah, how's Volvavin playtime going？
Kobayakawa
Hehehe, it's going great.
Huh, good for you.
"Tidy up！ Go, Volve Fusion！ Next, brush your teeth！"
Ah, I get it！
Right？ Our Volve Fusion sync rate is 120% now.
You know, ▲小早川＊▲ might make a surprisingly good mom.
"Surprisingly"？ Rinko's Volve Kick hurts, you know？
Sorry, sorry！
Kobayakawa
Hey, are you watching "Love, Lust, and How We Met"？
Oh, it's popular with girls, right？ I don't watch it, though.
You should.
Huh... So ▲小早川＊▲ watches dramas like that too？
Rinko's surprised too. At first I watched it to keep my new mom company. But it's actually pretty...
I see. Then maybe I'll watch it too.
Hmm... Guys won't get it.
What am I supposed to do...
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲, hey.
Hmm？
Just say Rinko told you "don't ask about my past." Could you still trust her？
Your past... like middle school or grade school？
No！ A woman's past means her romantic history.
Romantic history... Did something happen？
It's totally suspicious. Three of her past lovers vanished. This week we should finally find out.
(Oh, the drama...)
Kobayakawa
Ahh, geez！
Wh-What？
All three past lovers have amnesia？ No way！
Oh, "Love, Sorrow, and How We Met"？
Yeah. "Love, LUST," though. Geez, what a waste of worrying.
What was that twist？ I want to grill the writer. I'm done watching it！
Now, now, it's a drama.
So it's okay to cheat because it's a drama？ They'd better explain it all in the finale.
(So she's still watching...)
Kobayakawa
Sigh...
What's up... A sigh？ That's rare.
I watched the finale...
Ah, "Love, Lust, and..."
"How We Met." Sigh...
Right, right. The absurd one with the three amnesiac lovers...
No. It couldn't be helped. That's just how women are.
She loved too much. Guys can't understand.
Geez... Just leave Rinko alone right now.
(Yeah, I don't get it at all.)
Kobayakawa
Hmm... I wonder...
What？
▲主人公＊▲, um, have girls ever told you you're cool？
Huh？ Why？
No reason. So, have they？
Well, I guess it's not like it's never happened... So why？
Hara-chan said, "Rinko's boyfriend is cool."
Hara-chan？ Who's that, a friend？
Yeah, a girl in my class. She saw us together the other day...
I see... Yeah. She's got a good eye, huh？
Well, she's Rinko's friend. But... hmm, cool, huh...
You don't have to think that hard about it...
Kobayakawa
Oh yeah, the other day, someone confessed to Hara-chan！
Whoa！ Hara-chan's your classmate, right？
Yeah. And it's a guy she's never even talked to. Out of nowhere.
Huh... So what's she going to do？
She's thinking it over. It's weird, though. She doesn't even know what he's like.
But if someone says they like you, it doesn't feel bad, right？ And the guy worked up the nerve, too.
Rinko doesn't get it. Hara-chan falls for people way too easily.
Until recently, she wanted someone like Rinko's boyfriend, and this guy's totally different, you know？
Than me？ How？
Super popular.
Oh, I see...
Kobayakawa
Oh right！ In the end, Hara-chan decided to go out with him.
With Mr. Popular？
They're together all the time now. She promised to have lunch with Rinko, but then it was "Sorryyy～."
Sigh, so much for girls' friendship. Ugh！
Come on, don't say that. Maybe we've been doing the same thing to Hara-chan.
Yeah... Rinko thought about that too. Whether we were.
No, wait, that's different！ They're classmates, so they're always together. That's unfair！
▲主人公＊▲. Want to repeat a year？
Don't be ridiculous...
Kobayakawa
Hara-chan broke up.
That was fast！ ...Why？
When she really thought about it, she realized he wasn't right.
She said Rinko bragged about her boyfriend so much that she got a little jealous.
This time even Rinko reflected on it. I apologized for not noticing.
I see... Rough luck for Mr. Popular. But hey？
Hmm？
So ▲小早川＊▲ brags about me？
N-Not that much？
But Hara-chan said...
I don't！ Geez, shut up！
Kobayakawa
Um...
Hmm？
Rinko's younger than you, right？ How do you feel about that？
How do I feel... Why？
Nothing. Just wondering. Never mind, forget it？
Kobayakawa
Um...
Hmm？
Apparently high schoolers usually go for people older or the same age.
Is that so？
Rinko's the one asking.
Right, yeah.
...Would you actually rather have an older girl？ Wish your girlfriend were older？
Never mind. Forget I asked. Hehehe！
Kobayakawa
Hey... Sorry about that weird question. About liking older girls.
I've been thinking since then. Whether Rinko fell for you because you're older.
And I realized that's not it. Rinko would've fallen for you even if you were younger or the same age.
No matter how hard I try, I can't imagine anything but us as we are now. So I'm sure.
Yeah... For me too, older or younger, it's got to be ▲小早川＊▲.
Thanks... Hehehe. I almost cried.
(▲小早川＊▲... I've got to treasure her.)
Kobayakawa
Hey, I've been thinking again. About our age difference.
Again!? You're really stuck on that.
Now, now, just hear me out.
Okay, okay, what is it？
At our age, one year is like 1/16th or 1/17th of our lives, right？
Well, yeah？
But when we're around 32, it's 1/32nd. So the gap is half what it is now.
Oh, I get it！ At 40, even less, right？
Exactly！ By 50, I might pass you up？
Uh-oh... I can't slack off.
Hehehe！ But... it'd be nice if we could find out together what it's really like？
Yeah... it would.
Kobayakawa
Hey, are there foods you like or don't like？
Hmm... I don't have many, I think. Why？
No reason. It might come in handy.
What about you, ▲小早川＊▲？
Didn't I tell you before？ Potato chips！
Then foods you don't like？
None.
Really. I'd have thought you'd hate green peppers and carrots.
What am I, a kid!?
It's not that I CAN'T eat them, I just don't. Why go out of my way to eat gross stuff？
(She's definitely got a ton of dislikes.)
Kobayakawa
About food you like or hate...
Me？
Can you eat shiitake？ Raw oysters？ ...Um, green peas？
What's with the rapid fire？ What's up？
Because Rinko's the only one who gets told "Eat your vegetables！" It's so annoying！
Don't take it out on me. Besides, I never said that.
Well, since you've got the chance, why not learn to eat vegetables？
I told you, it's not that I can't eat them.
If big sis is picky, your little brother will copy her, you know？
...Somehow that ticks me off...
Go for it, big sis！
Eating some vegetables now？
Kobayakawa
I am lately. Got a problem？
You're really trying, huh？ Good girl, good girl.
What choice do I have？ When you say my brother will copy me...
Once you try them, they're not so bad, right？
Hmm... depends on the dish. But raw vegetables？ Makes no sense！
Lettuce and cabbage... when I think one of those squirmy THINGS might be on the leaves...
Aaaah！ No way！ Absolutely no way！
Having a few bugs means it's safer, you know？
Stop this conversation！ They're still crawling around in my head...
(What an imagination.)
So, how's the vegetable hating going？
Kobayakawa
Sorry, but I never said I hate them. And I eat vegetables every day.
Ooh. You can do it if you try.
Potatoes are vegetables, after all.
Potatoes... Don't tell me？
What？
You don't mean potato chips, do you？
They're genuine potatoes, fried nice and crispy？
Hey！ What if your brother starts eating chips every day too？
It's fine. I try not to eat them much in front of him.
(Is that the issue...)
Kobayakawa
Hey, how does Rinko look lately？ Haggard？
Hmm...？
The Kobayakawa family dinner table is facing a grave crisis.
What do you mean？
It started when Mom went on a diet.
Then Dad joined in, saying it was for his waistline.
And？
Carbs make you fat, so it's tofu instead of rice. Get it？ BEANS？
Geez！ We're Japanese, eat rice already！
(But her family seems happy... I think？)
Is the healthy diet still going？
Kobayakawa
Sort of... You've never felt love for rice, have you？
Well, I eat it every day without thinking.
Now boiled tomatoes are the big trend...
A tomato diet...？
Eat cooked tomatoes and the lycopene does something and boosts your metabolism.
If they raise the vegetable ratio any more, Rinko might starve to death...
What can I say... Believe in the future and hang in there.
The chips I secretly eat in my room at night are my emotional support.
(So she's still eating them... the chips.)
Kobayakawa
At last, the age of endurance has come to an end！
What are you talking about？
The diet menu's been lifted！
Oh, good for you.
Mom lost five kilos. For some reason, Dad didn't lose any, though.
Now just pray there's no rebound.
Don't jinx it. If that happens again, I'm totally running away from home.
And then I'll go to your place, so let me stay over.
Huh!? Stay over... Isn't that kind of a bad idea...？
Huh？ Obviously I'm joking...
(I got my hopes up a little...)
By the way, how's the dinner table since the diet craze ended？
Kobayakawa
Totally peaceful.
That's good.
The food's tasty, the couple's happy, my brother's cute. It's all right.
What？ Don't get all mushy.
Right. Happy family, the daughter's lovey-dovey with her boyfriend. No problem！
Huh？
Don't call us lovey-dovey yourself. Idiot.
Kobayakawa
Hey, anything you're into lately？
Not really. What about you, ▲小早川＊▲？
Rinko's into the "Divy-chan Collection." Palm-sized dolls. They're ugly-cute.
Ugly... and cute.
But you can't tell which one you got until you open the box.
Ah. One of those collectibles.
I completed the first series, and now it's the second. I'm almost done with this one too.
Doesn't that get pricey？ You okay？
Yeah, that's the problem. There's a CD I want this month too. Ugh, I wish my allowance would go up...
(When she gets into something, she goes all the way...)
Still into Divy-chan？
Kobayakawa
Of course！ When you're close to completing it, you keep getting doubles.
Yeah, that's how it goes.
So checking online auctions is Rinko's daily routine.
But don't the rare ones go for crazy prices？
Right. The ultra-rare version Rinko wants is 3,000 yen.
3,000 yen... How much are they normally？
300 a box.
That's a bit much...
It's like they're taking advantage of me. It ticks me off！
(And yet she'll collect them all anyway...)
Oh right, how'd that Divy-chan thing go？
Kobayakawa
Yeah. I did it！ Divy-chan Series Two, complete！
Ooh. Nice. How'd you get it？
In the end I won the auction for 3,000 yen... Now I can't buy the CD.
So you gave in to Divy-chan's temptation.
Divy-chan's ugly-cute little round eyes were pleading, "Buy me！ Buy me！"
Well, you can buy the CD next month, right？
Yeah, no regrets. But I'm not falling for that kind of racket again.
So what do you do with the collection？
Keep them safe in their boxes, of course. It'd be awful if my brother broke one.
(Is that really okay...？)
Kobayakawa
Hey, about Divy-chan...
Ah, the ugly-cute Divy-chan.
The third series, the "Sparkly-Cute ＆ Little-Bad ☆Edition," is coming out... What do I do？
Another one？ But didn't you quit Divy-chan？
But it's Sparkly-Cute ＆ Little-Bad!? It's dangerous. Too creepy-ugly-cute.
More wasted money... I can see it now.
But online they sell complete sets, so no doubles.
No doubles means no waste, right？
I-Is that how it works...？
Decided！ I'm buying a complete set！
(And then putting them in boxes...？)
You seem busy lately.
Kobayakawa
Kind of. Actually, Rinko started a short-term job. Expenses keep piling up lately.
Really!? What kind of job is it？
At a bookstore.
Very library committee of you. Is it going okay？
Don't treat me like a kid. Work is work. I get it done, no problem.
Ooh.
Though sometimes, while shelving books, I read a teeny bit.
Only sometimes！
(Is that okay...？)
So how's the part-time job going？
Kobayakawa
So-so. There's still a lot to learn.
What kind of work do you do？
Putting new books and magazines on shelves, manning the register, taking care of returns, stuff like that.
It's your first job, right？ How is it？
Well, I think I'm doing better than you think, at least？
I see. That's a relief.
What's that？ No need to worry. When it counts, Rinko gets things done.
Hahaha, true.
How's the bookstore job？
Kobayakawa
Oh, I quit.
Why？ Did you get fired？
Didn't I say it was short-term？
Oh, right.
It was kind of fun, so I might do it again.
Looking forward to your first paycheck？
Not really. Though I don't think anyone hates money？
(She says that, but I bet she's excited.)
Hey, you must've gotten paid by now, right？
Kobayakawa
What are you after？
That's a nasty thing to say...
Kidding. It's not much, but I've got a little financial breathing room now.
I'll buy books with it, and CDs. If there's any left, maybe clothes too？
Hahaha... It's great you're happy, but think before you spend it, okay？
What are you, my dad？ Don't worry. I took the job because there was stuff I wanted from the start.
Huh, what did you want？
Girls need money for all kinds of things！ I can't wear the same outfit on every date, right？
(I see, she was thinking about our dates...)
I might've asked before, but what music do you like, ▲小早川＊▲？ Specifically.
Kobayakawa
Hmm...
What's wrong？
When you ask me like that... Going on about it feels kind of childish.
Is it？ I want to know more about what ▲小早川＊▲ likes.
...Well, fine. Simply put, punk.
Is that different from rock？
Yes and no. Punk is a kind of rock.
Huh.
Never mind, this is kind of embarrassing.
(Why？)
How did you get into punk and Western music, ▲小早川＊▲？
Kobayakawa
My dad's influence, I guess.
So your music-loving dad trained you？
Nothing that grand. It was just around the house, so I heard it growing up, and it stuck.
Huh, do you still talk music with your dad？
Not really. Dad doesn't seem to listen much anymore.
I see. But if you still love it, it must really suit ▲小早川＊▲.
Maybe. Punk is the music of rebellion.
I see.
Though apparently Rinko's mellowed out lately. ...Thanks to someone.
(Who could that be？)
Don't you listen to new music, ▲小早川＊▲？
Kobayakawa
Not much, but I do sometimes.
So you check the hit charts too？
That stuff, I pass on.
I see.
No point listening to the same stuff as everyone. And why is it all love songs？ So naive.
Hmm, that's a tough one.
Today's hits are just too shallow, that's all.
But then don't you have trouble talking music with people？
Who cares. I'm not trying to be one of the crowd.
Maybe I should learn more about Western music too？
Kobayakawa
Huh？ Why？
Why？ Wouldn't ▲小早川＊▲ want a boyfriend with the same taste？
Nope, don't need it. You don't get it.
I see, so a newbie won't cut it.
That's not it. Well, that too.
Sure, if our tastes matched naturally, it might be fun. But pushing my hobbies on you would feel gross.
I don't see it that way, but if that's how ▲小早川＊▲ feels...
Don't connect with Rinko on surface stuff like that. Connect with her deeper down, at the roots.
That'd make Rinko happier.
Kobayakawa
Oh, we're getting our bathroom redone at home.
Like a renovation？
Yeah, that. So for a while we're going to the public bathhouse. It's kind of exciting.
It's not somewhere you usually go. I got way too excited once and got yelled at by some old guy.
Hey？ After the bath, do you drink fruit milk？
I don't really remember... maybe？
You put your left hand on your hip, look up and to the right at 45 degrees, and chug it in one go.
Is that so...？
Dad taught me that's the proper etiquette？
(Is that really true...)
So, have you been to the bathhouse yet？
Kobayakawa
Yeah. A big bath really feels great.
Did you know？ Bathhouses these days aren't just a big tub.
What do you mean？
There are jacuzzis, and water jets to loosen up stiff shoulders.
And there was a bath that zaps you with electricity.
Huh, so bathhouses have evolved.
It's like a little theme park.
(Maybe a bathhouse once in a while wouldn't be bad？)
So, are you still going to the bathhouse？
Kobayakawa
Yeah. By the way, bathhouse fees have three tiers: adult, middle, and child.
Adult and child I get, but what's middle？
I think it said "ages 6 to under 12."
Basically grade school. So middle schoolers pay adult price？
Seems so... And yet that bathhouse geezer looked at Rinko and...
Hm？
I'm getting mad. Never mind. End of story！
(What happened...？)
That bathroom renovation you mentioned, is it done？
Kobayakawa
It's done. And lo and behold！ It's all sparkly and brand-new.
So you don't go to the bathhouse anymore？
Nope. I kind of miss it, though.
But our bath at home got pretty amazing too.
It turns into a jacuzzi, and it has a mist sauna.
Ooh, sounds fancy. Must feel great.
Right？ Want to come try it？
Huh!?
Stop imagining weird stuff every time！
Anything fun lately？
Kobayakawa
Lately, the arcade's fun, I guess.
You've always liked that, ▲小早川＊▲, right？ Fighting games？
Yeah, but a new one came out, and it's really hot.
Huh.
Well, around the arcades here, Rinko's known as a powerhouse.
As the violent girl who throws a little kick the second she gets mad...
I'm talking about the GAME！
Ow！
What part of me is violent？
(That part！ Right there！)
Still going to the arcade？
Kobayakawa
Hya！ Little kick, thwack！
That hurts！ Why'd you kick me out of nowhere？
I took out my pent-up frustration！
Then don't use me as your outlet.
But I'm sooo frustrated！
Frustrated about what？
There's this player I just can't beat.
It's always a close match, but...
Argh！ Thinking about it makes me mad again！ Thwack！
(Don't kick me over it...)
You look down. Did something happen？
Kobayakawa
That Makoto player hasn't been coming to the arcade lately...
Makoto？ Oh, a game character. The player ▲小早川＊▲ just can't beat...
Right！ After I studied anti-Makoto tactics and went training at other arcades！
You went that far？ That's real tenacity, or whatever you'd call it...
If he never comes back, he wins by leaving on top.
And Rinko trained her Reiko into a Makoto-killer, too.
I get how you feel, but that part's up to him.
Thwack！
(Ouch！)
You seem in a good mood. Did something happen？
Kobayakawa
Yeah. I finally beat that strong Makoto player.
Nice. You got back at him.
Of course！ ...Well, I only won two out of thirteen.
And I worked up the nerve to talk to him. He said he'll keep coming by now and then.
...Huh.
What？ Jealous？
It's not that...
Don't worry. You're the Rinko-killer. Even that Makoto player's no match for you.
Kobayakawa
My parents are terrible.
What's up all of a sudden？
They put a potted cactus in my room without asking. "Rinko's room faces a bad direction."
A cactus... Why？
Feng shui, they said.
Feng shui. The thing about good and bad directions？
Yeah. Supposedly a cactus in a bad direction blocks bad energy.
It ruins the look of Rinko's room！
(Huh. First I've heard of that.)
Is feng shui still a thing at your house？
Kobayakawa
Sadly. And they told Rinko to take care of the cactus.
They put it there themselves. I don't know how to raise a cactus.
Well, most people don't, right？
So I looked it up online and I've been watering it and stuff, but...
Oh yeah, apparently cacti grow better if you talk to them.
Yeah, I saw that. But I can't do something that embarrassing.
A high school girl alone in her room talking to a cactus？ Not healthy.
(Is that so...)
How's that cactus doing？
Kobayakawa
Hm？ You mean our Tama？
Tama... Since when does ▲小早川＊▲'s family have a cat？
No. Tama the cactus. It's round like a ball, a "tama," so, Tama.
Got it. So is Tama growing okay？
Sort of... I didn't want to talk to it, so I play it music instead.
Huh, and？
I put the speakers next to Tama and it really grew！ It's not my imagination, it's obviously bigger！
Tama's a punk-loving cactus... Maybe it'll start headbanging someday.
(There was a toy like that once...)
That cactus... I mean, is Tama growing up healthy？
Kobayakawa
Yeah, it bloomed！ A cute pink flower.
With that prettiness, Tama's definitely a girl.
I don't think cacti have boys and girls...
Shut up, who cares, it's cute.
You're surprisingly into cute stuff, ▲小早川＊▲. Like cats.
Cats are special！
Rinko doesn't go "Kyaa, so cute！" over everything like other high school girls.
Yeah, true.
Your girlfriend is a woman of discerning taste.
